create_model_armor_guardrail: create a Google Cloud Model Armor guardrail instance with template_id, project_id, and location for LiteLLM
sanitize_user_prompt: sanitize a user prompt using Model Armor API to detect RAI, malicious URIs, and sensitive data before LLM call
sanitize_model_response: sanitize a model response using Model Armor API to filter harmful or sensitive content after LLM call
sanitize_file_prompt: sanitize a file (PDF, Word, Excel, CSV) by encoding it as base64 and sending to Model Armor for content filtering
block_content_if_unsafe: check Model Armor response to determine if content should be blocked based on RAI, SDP, or virus scan filter results
